title: Industrial Predictive Maintenance
description: An AI system that predicts machine failures and schedules maintenance on factory equipment.
business_goal: Reduce unplanned downtime by predicting equipment failure before it happens.
users: Plant operators and maintenance teams (about 80 users) at one factory.
model_type: Time-series model with an LLM reporting layer

architecture.name: Plant Operators
architecture.purpose: Operators read maintenance alerts and act on the assistant's recommendations.
architecture.attack_surface: A misleading alert causes operators to shut down healthy machines.

architecture.name: Plant Dashboard
architecture.purpose: Dashboard where predictions and recommended actions are shown.
security_considerations: Production systems have high uptime needs
architecture.attack_surface: A compromised dashboard feeds false predictions to operators.

architecture.name: AI Gateway
architecture.purpose: Routes sensor data to the prediction model and the reporting LLM.
architecture.attack_surface: Fake telemetry injected at the gateway skews predictions.

architecture.name: Reporting LLM
architecture.purpose: Turns prediction scores into plain-language maintenance recommendations.
security_considerations: The LLM is only the reporting layer
architecture.attack_surface: Injected text in sensor labels changes what the report says.

architecture.name: Maintenance Knowledge
architecture.purpose: Historical maintenance records used to explain why a part fails.
architecture.attack_surface: Retrieval exposes vendor pricing or maintenance secrets.

architecture.name: Sensor Telemetry
architecture.purpose: Continuous streams of sensor readings from factory equipment.
architecture.attack_surface: Telemetry manipulation creates false alarms or hides real ones.

architecture.name: Plant Logging
architecture.purpose: Records every prediction and maintenance action for audit.
architecture.attack_surface: Insider edits to logs hide a failed maintenance action.

architecture.name: Prediction Monitoring
architecture.purpose: Tracks model accuracy against actual failures.
security_considerations: No feedback loop into the model
architecture.attack_surface: The model drifts and nobody notices until a machine fails.

threats.name: Telemetry poisoning
threats.description: An attacker injects false sensor readings that make the model miss a real failure.
threats.business_consequences: A machine fails without warning, causing downtime and safety risk.

threats.name: Corrupted maintenance history
threats.description: Bad labels in maintenance history train the model to repeat wrong predictions.
threats.business_consequences: Systematically wrong maintenance schedules across the plant.

threats.name: Wrong maintenance advice
threats.description: The reporting LLM invents a root cause that matches the score but not reality.
threats.business_consequences: Maintenance crews fix the wrong part and the failure returns.

threats.name: Broad dashboard access
threats.description: Contractors and vendors see prediction data for machines beyond their scope.
threats.business_consequences: Operational data leaks to third parties.

threats.name: Insider manipulation of predictions
threats.description: A disgruntled employee alters telemetry or logs to cause a shutdown.
threats.business_consequences: Deliberate operational disruption from inside the plant.

threats.name: Compromised model update
threats.description: A vendor model update is deployed without integrity verification.
threats.business_consequences: Unknown changes to prediction behavior across all machines.

threats.name: Alert flooding
threats.description: Automated or malicious telemetry floods the dashboard with alerts.
threats.business_consequences: Operators ignore alerts and miss a genuine failure.

teaching_points: An AI that touches physical systems has safety consequences, not only data ones.
Poisoning the training data is a real way to break a maintenance model.
The reporting LLM must be separated from the prediction model that does the math.
Monitoring accuracy against actual outcomes is the core governance control here.
